name: Platform Prism
purpose: Answer each decision a content-addressed platform asks of its engineers, operators, security team and leaders, from conformance to rollout, by the app that models it, with every stated property proved in Lean. Send the name of one of conformance-verdict, kappa-label-check, upload-session, gc-eviction, vm-image-admission, rollout-gate or stakeholder-view, a space, then that app's fields; it answers as that app does, and invalid request for anything else.
inputLabel: Request: an app, then its fields

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: CV-01: the conformance-verdict app never answers ideal when must is above 0. CV-02: the conformance-verdict app never answers conformant when must is above 0. CV-03: the conformance-verdict app always answers conformant when config is ok and network is reachable and must is at most 0 and should is above 0. KLC-01: the kappa-label-check app never answers permit when axis is other. KLC-02: the kappa-label-check app never answers permit when hex is other. KLC-03: the kappa-label-check app never answers permit when digits is below 64. US-01: the upload-session app never answers committed when label is mismatch and state is not committed. US-02: the upload-session app always answers abandoned when event is timeout and state is not committed and state is not rejected. US-03: the upload-session app always answers committed when state is committed. US-04: the upload-session app always answers rejected when state is rejected. US-05: the upload-session app always answers abandoned when state is abandoned. GE-01: the gc-eviction app never answers evict when finalizer is outstanding. GE-02: the gc-eviction app never answers evict when tag is bound. GE-03: the gc-eviction app always answers evict when tag is none and pin is expired and finalizer is not outstanding and upload is none. VIA-01: the vm-image-admission app never answers permit when signature is not verified. VIA-02: the vm-image-admission app never answers permit when digest is mismatch. VIA-03: the vm-image-admission app never answers permit when site is airgapped and source is upstream. VIA-04: the vm-image-admission app always answers indeterminate when verifier is error. RG-01: the rollout-gate app never answers go when key is missing. RG-02: the rollout-gate app never answers go when conformance is untested. RG-03: the rollout-gate app never answers go when backup is not complete. RG-04: the rollout-gate app always answers no-go when conformance is nonconformant. SV-01: the stakeholder-view app never answers kappa-label-check when viewpoint is leader. SV-02: the stakeholder-view app never answers kappa-label-check when viewpoint is business. SV-03: the stakeholder-view app always answers rollout-gate when need is rollout and viewpoint is leader. SV-04: the stakeholder-view app always answers vm-image-admission when need is image and viewpoint is security.

proposition.name: dispatch
proposition.text:
conformance-verdict request := ConformanceVerdict.judge request
kappa-label-check request := KappaLabelCheck.judge request
upload-session request := UploadSession.judge request
gc-eviction request := GcEviction.judge request
vm-image-admission request := VmImageAdmission.judge request
rollout-gate request := RolloutGate.judge request
stakeholder-view request := StakeholderView.judge request
proposition.plain: Answer each decision a content-addressed platform asks of its engineers, operators, security team and leaders, from conformance to rollout, by the app that models it, with every stated property proved in Lean.
